name: Apple iPad (9th generation) Wi-Fi
shortDescription: iPad (9th generation) Wi-Fi with a 10.2-inch Retina display, A13 Bionic chip, Touch ID and 64 GB storage.
description:
The iPad (9th generation) has a 10.2-inch Retina display with True Tone and runs on the A13 Bionic chip. It supports Apple Pencil (1st generation) and the Smart Keyboard through the Smart Connector.

The front has a 12 MP Ultra Wide camera with Centre Stage for video calls, and the back has an 8 MP Wide camera. Apple quotes up to 10 hours of web browsing on Wi-Fi or video playback.

This is the Wi-Fi model with 64 GB storage. It has Touch ID in the Home button, a Lightning connector, a 3.5 mm headphone jack and stereo speakers.
highlights: 12 MP Ultra Wide front camera with Centre Stage, 8 MP rear camera
Touch ID, Apple Pencil (1st generation) support
Up to 10 hours battery life (Apple figure)
